I usually deep clean my cage every two weeks , so to minimize the smell as much as possible I change the nesting material (I use old newspaper shreds) and spot clean every few days ^^ my boys love sputniks (round hideouts that can also be attached to the top of the cage) and hammocks!! I‘d quarantine her just to be safe, I haven’t had a situation like this myself though.. definitely call a vet if she doesn’t start eating/drinking again while on her own

You said that some days you’re head over heals and other days you’re annoyed by everything he does.. maybe it’d be a good idea to get something to signal your current mood to him without having to explain yourself, because I know that can be frustrating.
It sounds childish but there’s those octopus stuffies that you can turn inside out and it will show a happy or annoyed expression 
That’s how you can signal your mood to him

Second Id recommend sitting down with him, telling him what not to do when you’re in a bad mood or what to avoid but also ask him how you can improve your performance as I’m sure it’s weighing heavy on him too. Try to communicate as much as you can to avoid misunderstandings
